title: Deferred Fixed Annuities Claims Standard: Valuation Interest on the Death Benefit
content:
**Product:** Deferred Fixed Annuities — the Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity and the Ashgrove SecureRate 3, 5, 6, 7 and 10.

## Standard

When an owner's death is on file, the contract's death benefit is valued by crediting the death benefit valuation interest, dated the day it is credited and closing on the valuation date, to the contract value.

| Aspect | Effect of the credit |
|---|---|
| When it applies | Whenever the death of the contract's owner is on file |
| Entry | One interest credit entry, dated the day it is credited, whose interest period closes on the valuation date |
| Contract value | Raised by the valuation interest |

## Waiting state

The death benefit valuation interest is fixed only after the contract carries its renewed guaranteed rate for every guarantee period that ended before the valuation date.

Restated: where a guarantee period of the contract ended before the valuation date and the contract does not yet carry the renewed guaranteed rate for it, the death benefit valuation interest is not yet fixed.

## Crediting tool: `credit_death_valuation_interest_0cf0ffa2`

**Capability.** Credits the interest that values a Deferred Fixed Annuities contract's death benefit: it records, dated today, one interest credit entry on a contract whose owner has died, marks the entry's interest period as ending on the valuation date given, and adds the interest to the contract's current contract value. Afterwards the activity history shows the new interest credit entry with its period end, and the contract shows the raised contract value.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, passing the tool name `credit_death_valuation_interest_0cf0ffa2` and its arguments.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `fixed_contract_id` | The reference number of the deceased owner's Deferred Fixed Annuities contract, as read from the contract lookup | Identifier, as recorded |
| `interest_amount` | The interest credited, in US dollars; it is added to the contract value as given | A positive amount with exactly 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |
| `valuation_date` | The date the death benefit is valued on, which closes the interest period | YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time or time zone) |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation: "Valuation interest <entry reference> credited to contract <contract reference>: <amount>; contract value now <value>." The entry reference is the new interest entry's reference number; amount and value are US dollar amounts with 2 decimal places. Receiving this line means the interest entry exists and the contract value has been raised by the amount. No other return is defined.
